features.name: credit_amount_per_month
features.description: Average monthly credit amount over the duration of the loan.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps tree models split on the monthly financial burden, which is often more predictive than total amount alone.

features.name: is_young_and_low_savings
features.description: Boolean indicator for applicants under 30 with low or no known savings.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures a specific demographic segment directly, saving the tree from needing multiple splits to find this interaction.

features.name: financial_stability_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of overall financial stability based on checking_status, savings_status, employment, and property_magnitude.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an ordinal ranking of financial health that tree models can easily threshold.

features.name: installment_burden_estimate
features.description: Proxy for the monthly installment burden, combining the monthly credit amount and the installment commitment rate.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a continuous feature representing the intensity of the repayment commitment, useful for thresholding.

features.name: has_critical_credit_history
features.description: Boolean indicator for applicants with a critical or other existing credit history.
features.expected_model_benefit: Isolates the most severe credit history category into a single binary split.

features.name: credit_to_age_ratio
features.description: Ratio of the requested credit amount to the applicant's age.
features.expected_model_benefit: Exposes the relationship between loan size and age, allowing trees to split on disproportionately large loans for younger individuals.

features.name: employment_stability_indicator
features.description: Semantic evaluation of the stability of employment and residence history, combining job type, employment duration, and residence duration.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates multiple categorical and ordinal stability indicators into a single ordinal feature for efficient splitting.

features.name: high_risk_purpose
features.description: Boolean indicator for loan purposes historically associated with higher variance in repayment (education, business, repairs).
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups specific categorical values into a single binary feature, reducing the depth required for the tree to isolate these purposes.

features.name: total_commitments
features.description: Sum of existing credits and number of dependents.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines two sources of financial obligation into a single integer feature.

features.name: no_checking_or_savings
features.description: Boolean indicator for applicants with no checking account and low or no known savings.
features.expected_model_benefit: Identifies individuals with minimal liquid assets, providing a strong binary split candidate.

features.name: asset_quality_index
features.description: Semantic evaluation of the quality and liquidity of assets based on property_magnitude, housing, and own_telephone.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an ordinal summary of asset wealth, simplifying multiple categorical splits into one thresholdable feature.

features.name: large_long_term_loan
features.description: Boolean indicator for loans over 5000 with a duration over 24 months.
features.expected_model_benefit: Explicitly flags high-exposure loans, providing a direct binary split for the tree.
